title: Axis-anchored multi-label event-relation full-population readiness
purpose: Qualify the corrected 819067-parameter GSE-Graph interface in which persistent, reveal and withdraw are independent binary relations, including the real same-bearing reveal-plus-withdraw cases that invalidate the categorical V1/V1R interface.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training V2 readiness audit over all sealed C01-C08 development observations plus eight fixed real backward-check observations; no optimizer, checkpoint, threshold selection, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution, approved in-scope operations, and explicitly requested no routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed deduplicated C01-C08 five-frame causal LiDAR/Teacher dataset.
Sealed V1/V1R readiness evidence retained as categorical-interface component and failure-ablation provenance.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective TNG/spline/mesh targets.

worlds.provenance_population: Exactly 80 C01-C08 worlds are read for representation completeness only; C07/C08 are reported separately and are not used to fit weights, thresholds or checkpoints.

sampling.rule: Rasterize each objective same-traversal past-to-current relation into three independent binary channels on 180 two-degree route-axis bins. Missing early pairs remain -1 masks. A duplicate physical exit within the same channel/bin fails; different channels may coexist.

teacher.source: Frozen TNG event/association/directed-exit identity plus spline/mesh axis and geometry fields already sealed in the dataset.
teacher.valid_mask: A relation pair is labeled only when both referenced frames have observation-level Teacher rows in the same directed traversal; branch, width and geometry masks remain independent.
teacher.student_input: Only five normalized causal range images and valid-return masks.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph is executed. Later nodes require stable learned events; later edges require physical traversal.

split.fit: C01-C06 counts alone define class weights.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: None in readiness; C07 is future validation and C08 future frozen development selection.
split.historical_pollution_audit: No checkpoint is loaded. V1/V1R categorical outputs are not reused as targets or selected evidence.

methods.main: Axis-anchored five-frame LiDAR model with independent persistent/reveal/withdraw binary fields, current branch geometry, event and descriptor heads.
methods.baseline: Categorical V1/V1R relation head, which cannot represent a same-bearing reveal and withdraw of different physical exits.
methods.fallback: Any full-population collision within one channel, population drift, invalid mask, nonfinite backward or equivariance failure stops before training and returns to representation design.

failure_policy: Do not delete conflicting rows, widen bins, collapse exit identities, tune from C07/C08, optimize, checkpoint, access C09/C10/M-TARE or enter graph/planner.
retention: Retain full-population summary, fixed real manifest, paper-ready figure/source, logs, environment, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: One CPU Teacher rasterization over 188126 observations and deterministic CUDA forward/backward on eight fixed observations
